title: ConfigSourceActionEnvelope
description: Machine-readable result of a non-interactive action that changes a checked-in Goobers config source.

action.description: Which config-source action produced this envelope.

version.description: Envelope version, incremented when the payload shape changes.

created.description: Config-source paths or logical asset roots installed by the action.

skipped.description: Config-source paths or logical asset roots left untouched because they were already current.

path.description: Absolute path to the config source tree.

nextCommand.description: Ready-to-run command that checks or validates the action result.
